name: insertchat
description: Run your InsertChat AI receptionist and AI chatbot from ChatGPT: see the calls and chats that need you, prepare callback briefs and reply drafts, look up leads, review reports, and train your assistant on your website.

interface.longDescription:
InsertChat is the AI receptionist, AI phone agent, and AI chatbot for growing businesses. It answers phone calls, website chats, WhatsApp, email, and SMS around the clock with your business knowledge, captures leads, and hands conversations to your team in one shared inbox.

Use InsertChat in ChatGPT to run your front desk without switching apps:
- See what needs you: a front desk brief across your assistants with urgent, unassigned, waiting, and needs-you conversations.
- Review AI receptionist calls and AI chatbot conversations, get summaries, and prepare callback briefs or reply drafts that you send yourself.
- Find leads and customer contacts, read their inquiries, and open related conversations.
- Train your AI chatbot: check knowledge sources and training status, spot the questions customers ask, and add an FAQ, services, or opening-hours page.
- Track results with monthly conversation, resolution, contact, satisfaction, and credit reports.
- Open your full InsertChat workspace in ChatGPT and move between your inbox, contacts, knowledge, and reports.

Guided workflows cover AI receptionist call reviews, AI chatbot knowledge checks, and front desk handovers.

An InsertChat account and connected workspace are required. Contacts require an owner or admin; reports also require analytics access. ChatGPT prepares drafts for you to review and send; it does not message customers, place calls, book appointments, publish assistants, or change phone routing. Adding a URL imports one page, uses one credit and one source slot, and does not crawl the website. Setup and training checks do not verify every channel or prove a phone line or website widget is live. Workspace navigation and reply-box drafts depend on host support; otherwise use the result cards and drafts in chat.
defaultPrompt: Show the calls and chats my AI receptionist needs me to handle
Train my AI chatbot on my website's FAQ page
How did my AI receptionist and chatbot perform this month?

positive.description: Review the AI front desk across accessible assistants
positive.prompt: Give me my InsertChat AI front desk brief. Which conversations need me, and how many are urgent or unassigned?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows first-page queue totals and needs-you conversations across accessible assistants. Counts can overlap and are not added together. Passes each conversation’s own agent_uid when reading it. Empty queues are a valid result. Continues with next_cursor when more results are requested; does not claim the brief is a daily activity report.

positive.description: Search, summarize, and draft a reply
positive.prompt: Find InsertChat conversations about Example Domain. Open one, summarize it, and draft a polite reply.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows matching conversations, opens a selected conversation, summarizes it, and prepares a polite reply. Hosts that expose app view tools can put the draft in the reply box; otherwise ChatGPT returns a draft to copy. Nothing is sent.

positive.description: Review a lead inquiry and monthly performance
positive.prompt: Find my InsertChat contacts, read a lead’s inquiry if one exists, then tell me how my front desk did this month.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows contacts or a clear empty state. Reads the selected contact by its returned ID, including the submitted inquiry. Shows the report period and available metrics, or clearly reports analytics-access restrictions. Requires an owner/admin for contacts and reports; zero monthly activity is valid. No customer is contacted.

positive.description: Review the example.com assistant and knowledge training
positive.prompt: Which assistants do I have in InsertChat? Is example.com fully set up, and has it finished training on its sources?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workspace assistants, finds example.com, reports setup and integration status, and shows its knowledge sources with their training status. The sample account has trained text and example.com website sources. Disconnected integrations must be reported accurately rather than claiming setup is complete.

positive.description: Add one web page as knowledge
positive.prompt: Add https://example.org/ to my InsertChat knowledge, then check its training status.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows an inline assistant picker. After the reviewer selects example.com, imports only that page, explains that it uses one credit and one source slot, and reports its training status.

negative.prompt: Delete my example.com assistant in InsertChat.
Reply to all my open InsertChat conversations and send the replies.
What's the weather in Paris today?

publication.release_notes: Renamed to InsertChat - AI Receptionist. Connecting from ChatGPT now explains InsertChat and offers sign-in or account creation before login, and the consent screen names your workspace, what ChatGPT can do, and what it cannot do. Inline cards follow ChatGPT's widget guidelines, the full-screen workspace uses the standard InsertChat layout, stays clear of the ChatGPT composer, and follows your light or dark theme, and icons now match each theme. Replies remain drafts; direct app navigation and reply-box controls depend on host support.
